title: Electronic engine controls — 2.3L EcoBoost (231kW/314PS)
introduction:
An engine brings air, fuel and combustion together to produce crankshaft rotation. I start with that shared job before treating its controls as a collection of mysterious boxes: understanding the arrangement gives the cast of components a plot.

For this engine, the operating explanation is in the manual reference below. This page is a reading guide to that material; it contains no component descriptions, electrical tests or repair instructions. Keep the engine identification in view when selecting the applicable manual material.

edits.text: Start with the system's operating description to put the individual components in context.
